You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0121.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
im=Image.open('mol_0121.png');print(im.size); im.crop((690,125,1000,270)).resize((1240,580)).save('crop.png')
PY

cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
coords=[(158,19),(280,55),(397,21),(224,128),(339,97),(456,128),(571,97),(687,128),(705,161),(746,171),(630,201),(515,170),(398,201),(456,249),(571,277),(687,336),(746,232),(144,106),(224,249),(340,293),(456,168),(456,209),(723,194),(768,229),(868,201),(982,201),(766,103),(805,254),(470,323),(590,351)]
elements=['C']*len(coords)
for i,el in {19:'N',26:'O',27:'H',28:'H',29:'H'}.items():elements[i]=el
edges=[(0,1),(0,3),(1,2),(2,5),(3,4),(3,17),(3,18),(4,5),(4,12),(5,6),(5,20),(6,7),(6,10),(7,8),(9,10),(9,24),(9,26),(9,27),(10,11),(10,14),(11,12),(12,19),(13,19),(13,14),(13,21),(13,28),(14,15),(14,29),(15,16),(16,22),(16,23),(18,19),(24,25)]
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for el in elements:rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el))
for i,j in edges:rw.AddBond(i,j,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if (i,j)==(24,25) else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m=rw.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
c=Chem.Conformer(len(coords))
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(coords):c.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x/85.,-y/85.,0))
m.AddConformer(c)
# narrow end -> broad end of solid wedge; 2d implicit z more positive for broad atom
wedges=[(3,0,'up'),(5,2,'up'),(6,10,'up'),(9,24,'up'),(16,23,'up'),(14,29,'up'),(13,28,'down')]
for a,b,kind in wedges:
 bond=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(a,b)
 assert bond
 if bond.GetBeginAtomIdx()!=a:bond.SetBeginAtom(m.GetAtomWithIdx(a));bond.SetEndAtom(m.GetAtomWithIdx(b))
 bond.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE if kind=='up' else Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,force=True,cleanIt=True)
print('CIP',[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?',str(a.GetChiralTag())) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED]);print('smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetAtomicNum()==1 and a.GetIdx()<30:print('explicit H',a.GetIdx(),a.GetNeighbors()[0].GetIdx())
ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3();ps.randomSeed=128;ps.maxIterations=1000;ps.useRandomCoords=True
ret=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,ps)
print('embed',ret)
if ret<0:
 for seed in range(20):
  ps.randomSeed=seed+114;ps.useRandomCoords=False
  ret=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,ps)
  if ret==0:print('success seed',seed);break
if ret>=0:
 props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
 print('mmff',AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=2000) if props else 'not available')
 conf=m.GetConformer();f=open('initial.xyz','w');f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nGenerated from supplied 2D molecular drawing\n')
 for atom in m.GetAtoms():
  v=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx());f.write(f'{atom.GetSymbol()} {v.x:.8f} {v.y:.8f} {v.z:.8f}\n')
 f.close()
 print('stereo',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m,includeUnassigned=True))
PY
python build.py
